{"code": "import os, boto3, httpx, json

GW = os.environ["FABRIC_GATEWAY_MCP_URL"]
REGION="us-east-1"

class SigV4(httpx.Auth):
    requires_request_body = True
    def auth_flow(self, request):
        from botocore.auth import SigV4Auth
        from botocore.awsrequest import AWSRequest
        creds = boto3.Session().get_credentials().get_frozen_credentials()
        r = AWSRequest(method=request.method, url=str(request.url),
                       data=request.content, headers={"Content-Type":"application/json"})
        SigV4Auth(creds,"bedrock-agentcore",REGION).add_auth(r)
        request.headers.update(dict(r.headers)); yield request

# List tools on the gateway via signed MCP
from strands.tools.mcp.mcp_client import MCPClient
from mcp.client.streamable_http import streamablehttp_client
client = MCPClient(lambda: streamablehttp_client(GW, auth=SigV4()))
try:
    with client:
        tools = client.list_tools_sync()
        for t in tools:
            name = getattr(t,"tool_name",None) or getattr(t,"name",None) or t
            print("TOOL:", name)
            spec = getattr(t,"tool_spec",None) or {}
            if spec: print("   desc:", str(spec.get("description",""))[:160])
except Exception as e:
    print("ERR", type(e).__name__, str(e)[:400])
"}
